name: Cincinnati
summary: A handsome river city of hills and a famous chili — with a suspension bridge that was a rehearsal for Brooklyn's. The last stop in the Midwest.

lodging.name: A downtown or Over-the-Rhine hotel
lodging.blurb: Near the riverfront and the breweries.

foodMustTry.name: Cincinnati chili (a 3-way)
foodMustTry.blurb: Chili over spaghetti with a mound of cheese — plus goetta.

days.label: Day 704 — The Riverfront
days.summary: Chili, a market, and a bridge.

item.title: Riverfront & Findlay Market
item.blurb: Walk the Roebling Bridge (Brooklyn's prototype) and Smale Park, then Findlay Market and historic Over-the-Rhine.

item.title: Cincinnati Museum Center at Union Terminal
item.blurb: Three museums inside a stunning Art Deco train station.

days.label: Day 705 — East to Pittsburgh
days.summary: Into Appalachia — the Midwest is done.

commute.scenicNote: East across the hills to Pittsburgh and the final leg home.
